recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as-is. The remaining FHIR-15755 requirements are already represented by the current Composition definition, Composition notes, and extension-pack section-subject definition; broader family-history focus questions should wait for a final decision on later issues such as FHIR-54500.
issue_request: FHIR-15755 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3 Composition. It requested Composition.section.focus, a composition-section-subject extension, an example about a mother and child with a section focus different from the Composition subject, and logical-subject guidance for focused sections.
initial_application: Historical commit 832f5cb8c6 added Composition.section.focus, the multi-entity Composition notes, and composition-example-mixed.xml. Current core source still has the focus element and SHALL logical-subject wording, and the section-subject extension is now in the FHIR Extension Pack. The active mixed example, however, did not include a focus element on the mother section.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini and composition-example-mixed is listed in source/composition/list-Composition-examples.xml. Later FHIR-27891 changed document-bundle inclusion wording involving Composition.section.focus but did not alter section focus semantics. Later FHIR-54500 is Triaged and unresolved, so it was treated only as background.
reconciliation: Changed source/composition/composition-example-mixed.xml to add a Composition.section.focus reference to Patient/infant-mom in the mother section and corrected that section's title typo from "Mpther's Details" to "Mother's Details".
source_changes: source/composition/composition-example-mixed.xml: added focus Reference(Patient/infant-mom) to the mother section so the example demonstrates a section focus different from Composition.subject.
source/composition/composition-example-mixed.xml: corrected the mother section title from "Mpther's Details" to "Mother's Details".
